title: LoRa TDMA telemetry (proposed contract)

event_id.description: Gateway-origin stable Event ID assigned once on durable first acceptance of authenticated RF frame; retained through RF retransmit, reboot/offline queue and MQTT QoS1 replay. Gateway retains mapping from (gateway_id,node_id,security_session,frame_counter) to original ID; exact encoding pending G2/G4.

gateway_epoch.description: Originating Gateway boot epoch for this Event ID; preserve original value with persisted event across Gateway reboot/replay. A re-reception must not replace a previously durably assigned event ID.

event_seq.description: Gateway-assigned uint64 Event sequence in original gateway_epoch; stable for this logical event, never increment for duplicate RF reception or MQTT redelivery.

observed_at.description: Event occurrence time (UTC Z) only when a defensible time source exists. Null when unknown; never silently backfill with ingest time.

radio_rx_monotonic_us.description: Gateway-local monotonic microseconds; meaningful only within gateway_epoch. Do not compare across boots.

buffered.description: Offline spool/MQTT replay; retain the original Gateway event_id, gateway_epoch, event_seq and measurement. Repeated RF frames MUST map to same persisted Event ID.

node_id.description: Node ID in range 1..254, scoped to gateway_id (C06); authenticated source must match the provisioned mapping.

temp_x10.description: Temperature Celsius multiplied by 10; raw signed 16-bit value, e.g. 35.5 C -> 355. Byte order/rounding/error sentinel OPEN G2.

frame_counter.description: Node RF FRAME_COUNTER candidate uint32, scoped with authenticated Node and security session; 4-byte wire width remains draft G2. Not Event ID.

description: DRAFT owner-updated: Gateway-origin Event ID; RF Node transmits TEMP_X10 only for Telemetry, does not transmit Event ID; Backend dedup Gateway event_id, detect payload conflict. Authentication, nonce and exact wire format NOT_VERIFIED.
